As an Annotation Specialist, you will work on a team of dedicated individuals alongside our R&D Engineers and Researchers to advance the state-of-the-art in computer vision. Annotation is critical to the success of many of our computer vision projects; the annotations are used in scoring and evaluating our work as well as training our algorithms. Kitware’s Annotation team provides the key data annotation support within our computer vision team to meet these needs. The team uses a variety of software tools to label objects, activities, events, and other items of interest in images and video. This is an as-needed, project-dependent position with variable hours. jobs.description_text: Earn your master's degree while building real-world open source software. Kitware's Open Source Software Technology Program (OSTP) is a full-time position for talented and curious new Computer Science and Computer Engineering graduates, offering an opportunity to launch their careers while earning a master's degree in Computer Science. You'll work on real-world open source software projects, develop your technical and leadership skills, and complete your graduate education - all while earning a competitive salary. You'll gain experience developing innovative software with applications across areas such as computer vision, scientific computing, data and analytics, medical computing, and software solutions. Along the way, you'll learn not only how to build and maintain powerful open source platforms, but also how successful technical projects are led, funded, and sustained. How it Works OSTP Software Developers join Kitware as full-time, permanent employees from day one. The program is designed to combine professional software development experience with graduate study, with the master's degree typically completed over a three-year period. Throughout that time, you'll work on-site at Kitware's Clifton Park, NY headquarters while completing your master's coursework. jobs.description_text: Lead Program Systems Engineer, Cyclops DESCRIPTION The Lead Systems Engineer for the Cyclops Interceptor Program owns system level requirements, architecture, interface definition, and verification planning for Long Wall’s interceptor. jobs.description_text: LilEngine is leading the Lakehouse, a company-strategic effort to make Apache Iceberg a first-class citizen in Spotify's data ecosystem. We're building it in close collaboration with Google, on open standards, so that different kinds of data are queryable the same way and teams can bring the right engine, from BigQuery to Dataflow to Trino, to the job. The work has two parts. Hecate enables Iceberg for the Parquet datasets that already exist across Spotify, so teams get the benefits without rewriting their data. Alongside it, we're building the foundations of a new Lakehouse architecture that lets workflows write Iceberg tables natively. We're shipping the MVP this cycle, and you'll help shape what comes next. We also own BigQuery for all of Spotify. Thousands of engineers, data scientists and pipelines depend on it every day, which puts us on the critical path for storing, finding and querying data. We're judged on reliability, cost efficiency and how quickly we unblock users when something breaks. jobs.title: Backend Engineer II - Data Platform
jobs.description_text: Every dataset at Spotify, from the data behind creator royalties to the signals powering recommendations, is registered, published and traced through systems our team builds. We're the source of truth for what data exists at Spotify, where it lives, who owns it, and how it flows from one pipeline to the next. These systems sit on the critical path of the platform. Data teams use them every day to publish and find data, and other platform teams build on them for access, retention, governance and incident response. That means our work is judged on correctness and reliability, because every system built on top of ours is only as good as the metadata we provide. This is a backend role focused on data management, working on the problems at the core of any large data platform: running a data catalog that stays accurate at scale, capturing lineage across batch and streaming workloads, managing schemas as they evolve, and guaranteeing that consumers only read complete data. We build on open standards like OpenLineage and Apache Iceberg, and define the internal standards for naming, storage and metadata that the rest of Spotify builds against. As the platform takes on new storage technologies and new kinds of data assets, those standards and the systems behind them have to evolve with it, and you'll help decide how.

jobs.description_text: Reporting to the Director, Service Management, the successful candidate will provide technical and team leadership for the testing, quality assurance, release management, and production operations of Lightspeed business and technical applications and platforms. jobs.title: Manager, Revenue and Receivables
jobs.description_text: Telesat (Nasdaq and TSX: TSAT) is a leading global satellite operator, providing reliable and secure satellite-delivered communications solutions worldwide to broadcast, telecommunications, corporate and government customers for over 55 years. Backed by a legacy of engineering excellence, reliability and industry-leading customer service, Telesat has grown to be one of the largest and most successful global satellite operators. Telesat Lightspeed, our revolutionary Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite network, scheduled to begin service in 2027, will revolutionize global broadband connectivity for enterprise and Government users by delivering a combination of high capacity, security, resiliency and affordability with ultra-low latency and fiber-like speeds. Telesat is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada, and has offices and facilities around the world. The company’s state-of-the-art Satellite fleet consists of 12 GEO satellites, the Canadian payload on ViaSat-1 and one LEO 3 demonstration satellite. For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Manager, Revenue and Receivables is responsible for overseeing the revenue accounting and billing functions for Telesat and its subsidiaries, credit and collections for the Consolidated group of companies, and implementation and maintenance of revenue reporting and related controls.

This is as much a technical and program-delivery leadership role as it is a customer role: you will bring genuine engineering fluency and deep program management discipline to steer a complex, multi-segment space and ground system from build through to in-service operation.

Working within the User Terminal Engineering organization, the Senior Engineering Delivery Manager partners closely with Engineering Managers, Product Management, Program Management, Systems Engineering, Verification & Validation, Architecture teams, and the Solution-level Release Train Engineer (RTE) to manage cross-functional dependencies, integration readiness, execution risks, and release delivery. As the delivery lead for the Core UT segment, the role provides execution visibility, dependency management, release readiness, and milestone status into the broader Lightspeed Solution Train, ensuring alignment with solution-level objectives, Program Increment commitments, and release plans. This role focuses on engineering execution leadership and delivery coordination rather than direct people management, product ownership, project management, or architectural decision-making.

The Senior Manager, PMO has a staff who serve as the central integrators across engineering, operations, supply chain, finance, mission assurance, product management, and other stakeholder organizations supporting multiple projects. jobs.title: 車両テストエンジニア・AD/ADAS Application
jobs.description_text: ウーブン・バイ・トヨタについて ウーブン・バイ・トヨタは、トヨタの100年に一度のモビリティ・カンパニーへの変革に寄与していきます。「自分以外の誰かのために」発明を続けたという歴史からインスピレーションを受けた私たちのミッションーそれは、モビリティの定義を拡げ、そしてモビリティが社会に貢献する方法を拡張し、人を想うイノベーションで、モビリティの常識に挑み続けることです。 私たちは4つの柱を中心に活動しています：自動運転・先進運転支援システム技術のAD/ADAS、SDV（ソフトウェア定義車両）のための車両ソフトウェア生産プラットフォームであるArene、モビリティのテストコースであるWoven City、そして協業基盤を支えるデジタル・インフラストラクチャのCloud & AIです。また、ビジネスに不可欠な機能がこれらのチームの実装を下支えし、一丸となって「事故ゼロ社会」と「幸せの量産」の実現に向けて取り組んでいます。 ========================================================================= チームについて Teammate Driving (POV BEV) チームは、自動運転システムにおける最も基本的な機能の1つである車線維持機能と、自動運転システムで使用される地図情報提供サービスを開発しています。テストエンジニアのミッションは、システム要件に基づいて実装されたソフトウェアの機能、性能、品質基準を設定し、評価し、設計者にフィードバックし、製品の性能と品質を向上させることです。また、これらの製品をトヨタの次世代運転支援システム「Toyota Safety Sense」と「Teammate」に実装し、世界中の顧客により安全な運転とより快適なモビリティを提供します。 求める人材 私たちは、ソフトウェアのパフォーマンスと品質を向上させるために、AD/ADAS車両評価の運用と問題分析を行い、問題解決を推進できるエンジニアを探しています。また、ソフトウェアエンジニア、テストドライバ、さまざまな協力者と良好な関係を築くために、新しい価値を提案し、効果的にコミュニケーションできる人材を求めています。尚、定期的に東京・日本橋のオフィスに出社し、静岡県東富士のテストコースで実地試験の実施が必要となります。 業務内容 プロジェクトの進捗状況に合わせた評価計画の策定と管理 システム要件を満たすテストシナリオの作成 実車でのテストと特定された問題の原因の特定 アジャイル開発における問題管理と解決の推進 必須条件 以下のスキルと経験が必要です。 ・技術 ・車両評価業務 ・ユーザー視点でソフトウェア要件が満たされていることを検証する能力 ・Gitによるソフトウェア管理能力 ・AD（自動運転）/ADAS（先進運転支援システム）に関する知識と各技術の相互作用の理解 ・管理 ・優れた問題解決能力、仮説検証能力、タスク管理能力 ・ドキュメンテーション能力 ・さまざまな情報を体系化し、首尾一貫した計画を立案する能力 ・言語 ・日常的な場面で使われる日本語を理解できる能力。（例：日本語能力試験N2以上、または同等のレベル）

jobs.title: Analyste en Planification des Actifs
jobs.description_text: Chez Lyft, notre mission est de servir et de connecter. Nous y parvenons en favorisant un environnement de travail où chacun trouve sa place et a la possibilité de s'épanouir. Lyft Urban Solutions fournit les systèmes de vélos et de trottinettes en libre-service qui permettent à des millions de personnes de se déplacer dans plus de 60 villes à travers le monde. Nous avons créé le premier système de vélos en libre-service automatisé d'Amérique du Nord et restons à la pointe de la révolution de la micromobilité. Nos systèmes sont présents partout dans le monde : de Citi Bike à New York à BIXI à Montréal, en passant par Divvy à Chicago, Capital Bikeshare à Washington D.C., et des systèmes emblématiques à Austin, Barcelone, Bogota, Boston, Buenos Aires, Columbus, Détroit, Dubaï, Londres, Madrid, Mexico, Monaco, Pittsburgh, Portland, Rio de Janeiro, San Francisco, Toronto et bien d'autres villes. Nous ne sommes pas de simples fournisseurs de technologies : nous exploitons ces systèmes, en développant les logiciels, le matériel et les opérations qui permettent à la micromobilité urbaine de fonctionner à grande échelle. Learn more about our products, vision, values, and status as a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) on our website. Consulting is changing, and we’re not like other firms. Launched in 2019, Veeva Business Consulting has grown quickly and organically to over 500 global experts who combine deep domain knowledge with innovative technology to help Life Sciences companies work in a more efficient and connected way. We are growing aggressively as we look towards 2030. We are seeking great people to help shape the future of the industry with the world’s leading software, data, AI, and expertise at their back. The Role The Global Analytics Business Consulting Team applies data science and AI to help customers turn commercial, medical, and regulatory data into action. We are seeking a Global Data Science Lead that will support execution of the Data Science AI strategy within this team. This role will lead a group of data scientists, AI/ML engineers, and analysts, and partners with Global Analytics leadership to turn strategy into delivery — applying advanced analytics, machine learning, and generative AI/LLM techniques to life sciences data.

jobs.title: Head of Client Success and Delivery
jobs.description_text: Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead. At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors. As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment. Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities. The Role The Head of Client Success and Delivery will drive enterprise retention through product adoption and drive long-term customer value creation the client portfolios. If you're ready to lead transformational client success initiatives and make a lasting impact on our business and our clients, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Implementation Consultant - Software (Remote)
jobs.location_raw: Germany - Berlin · United Kingdom - London · Spain - Barcelona
jobs.description_text: The Role You will partner with top global pharma organisations to solve critical business challenges. By implementing Veeva’s Commercial Cloud products (PromoMats/DAM, and Medical), you will deliver cutting-edge, AI-powered solutions that drive the life sciences industry toward more connected, data-driven customer relationships. You’ll lead business process due diligence, design and implement robust and scalable solutions, and drive successful projects, through a variety of roles including Project Manager, Lead Solution Architect and PO/Business Analyst. What makes us different: Autonomy and high trust and ownership culture: passion and effort directly lead to opportunities and real ownership from the start Collaboration without competition: peers root for each other’s success, leadership is entirely accessible, and we tackle complex problems with a strict "no-ego" approach. Meaningful Industry Impact: know your work makes a difference, by helping life sciences companies operate more efficiently and effectively The ability to travel domestically and abroad is required (VISA not being handled by Veeva). The ideal candidate will be fluent in English and ideally one of the following languages: French, German, Italian, or Spanish. The role is ideally based in the area of a Veeva office (Barcelona, London, Paris, Frankfurt, Berlin), but other EU locations will be considered.

jobs.title: Junior Payroll Specialist
jobs.description_text: The Role The Veeva Systems EMEA Payroll team is hiring for an ambitious, detail-oriented Junior Payroll Specialist with 1–2 years of Hungarian payroll experience who is ready to accelerate their career in a dynamic, high-performance culture. In this role, you will take true E2E ownership of Hungarian payroll calculations while collaborating closely with supportive senior team members to develop your skills in multi-country European (EMEA) operations. Backed by accessible leadership and modern tools, this is an ideal role for a driven professional seeking continuous growth. You will step beyond local statutory processing to tackle new intellectual challenges, building deep expertise in international compliance, vendor management, and complex cross-border payroll.

jobs.title: Lead Consultant / Project Manager - Quality Cloud
jobs.location_raw: Ireland - Dublin · Hungary - Budapest · Poland - Cracow · United Kingdom - London · Spain - Barcelona
jobs.description_text: The Role Are you a passionate and curious individual with a relentless drive for delivering successful software implementations? Do you enjoy tackling large-scale, complex problems and leading high-energy teams focused on transforming the way Life Sciences companies bring drugs to market? We are looking for a senior, self-motivated Lead Consultant to join our Professional Services team. You'll be at the forefront of our mission, leading a team of Veeva colleagues and working side-by-side with one of our key enterprise customers. As a primary customer liaison, you will build long-term relationships and act as a customer advocate, guiding them in the adoption of industry best practices and providing value through agile delivery. You'll leverage your existing background in Life Sciences software implementation and program/project management while innovating and developing novel approaches to project delivery. You’ll be responsible for empowering enterprise companies with best-of-breed cloud-based technology.

jobs.title: Lead Services Engagement Manager (SEM) - eCOA
jobs.description_text: The Role The Services Engagement Manager Lead (SEM) is responsible for setting our customers up for success and representing the entire value proposition and effort behind a Veeva eCOA Implementations. This is a critical role in ensuring successful customer engagements during the scoping and planning phase to establish the right strategy for implementation success. The SEM is an integral part of the sales cycle, acting as a solution expert working in close alignment with the Veeva Sales, Strategy, and Services Teams.

jobs.title: Managed Services Consultant - Commercial Vault (Remote)
jobs.location_raw: Wisconsin - Madison · Pennsylvania - Philadelphia · Massachusetts - Boston
jobs.description_text: The Role Love consulting but tired of the travel? Looking for an opportunity to do something new, exciting, and with a clear value proposition for your customer? Veeva Systems is looking for a Managed Services Consultant who has a passion for helping customers achieve their business vision. The Managed Services Consultant is a member of our Commercial Services team who provides ongoing professional services for customers live with Veeva’s commercial and medical content management solutions (Vault PromoMats & Vault Medical). This is a remote, full-time permanent role with Veeva. There is no work location requirement. This is a customer-facing, non-travel role. There may be travel opportunities at select times of the year for internal events. Veeva Systems does not anticipate providing sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B, OPT) for this employment position.

jobs.title: Manager Corporate Events
jobs.description_text: The Role This is a key contributor role with Veeva’s North America marketing team. The role is primarily responsible for food and beverage (F&B) planning and management for large-scale internal and customer events within the U.S. The successful candidate must be able to focus on the pre-planning and execution side of food and beverage for events, be an operational contributor for all day-to-day processes, manage and reconcile F&B budgets, support execution of tactics, activities, and other details. Secondary responsibilities will include supporting and/or managing other event planning workstreams as defined by manager. Must be a team player working collaboratively with marketing and cross-functional teams.

jobs.title: NetSuite Developer
jobs.description_text: The Role The NetSuite Developer is responsible for the development, maintenance, and technical solutions for the existing NetSuite solution. The role will work closely with the IT Finance team as well as Finance business team to implement new features, troubleshoot issues, and improve the overall technical aspects of the application. The NetSuite Developer will be focused on increasing the system functionality and efficiency through AI, custom development within and around the application. Additionally, the NetSuite developer will work with the Integration team on creating efficient and seamless integrations with other platforms in the enterprise landscape.

jobs.title: Product Expert – Veeva RIM Submissions, Archive, and Publishing
jobs.location_raw: Germany - Berlin · Spain - Barcelona · United Kingdom - London
jobs.description_text: The Role Veeva is looking for a highly motivated individual with real-world life science industry experience in Regulatory Operations or Regulatory Affairs to drive customer success with our Veeva Regulatory Information Management (RIM) products in Europe. If you are a person who has a blend of experience building regulatory submissions and understanding of the key technical product features behind these processes, then this could be the role for you! Product Experts play a key role in the product organization, supporting software product managers specialising in Submissions, Submissions Archive and Publishing applications. You will advocate the voice of the customer by creating problem statements, using a blend of your industry knowledge, experience with European/ ROW regulations, and an understanding of real need behind the ask, to help shape the product roadmap for Submissions, Submissions Archive, and Publishing. Product Experts build strong relationships within the Veeva RIM community, lead educational campaigns, create content to showcase Veeva RIM, and represent the product organization in online communities, customer meetings and at industry events. This role is ideal for someone passionate about RIM processes, eager to collaborate with customers from end users to executives, and excited to drive their success. You should have the skills and personal characteristics to work with autonomy, proactiveness and drive – demonstrating the ability to succeed where there is am

jobs.title: Product Manager - OpenData Malaysia
jobs.description_text: The Role Veeva’s OpenData team is expanding the Product rapidly across Asia. We are looking for an entrepreneurial, energetic Product Manager who can lead OpenData in Southeast Asia. The vision of OpenData is to help the life sciences industry better connect with the healthcare ecosystems in order to improve care. The Product provides comprehensive reference and profile information on key aspects of healthcare, together with the insights needed by the industry. As the Product Manager for Southeast Asia, you will build and deploy the Product in key markets. You will be responsible for the Product Strategy and Feature Roadmap of OpenData and be passionate about product excellence and customer success. You will need to apply your intuition and experience to make good decisions around the product direction and strategy in your markets. You will also play a critical role, working together with the OpenData leadership, to define the right go-to-market approach. This role will require an ability to creatively problem solve, build strategic relationships in the market and lead. You coach and direct the product development team on building a quality Product. You will work together with our commercial teams to decide on the appropriate marketing activities for the Product. You will execute good analytics to support the success of customers using our Product. This role will be based in Singapore.

jobs.description_text: The Role Veeva is seeking a Product Manager, who will be responsible for defining, designing, and delivering critical features used by Regulatory professionals at many of the world’s largest Life Sciences companies. jobs.title: Product Marketing Associate Manager - Commercial Content
jobs.location_raw: Massachusetts - Boston · New York - New York City
jobs.description_text: The Role We are in search of exceptional product marketing talent to help us promote highly scalable, cloud solutions that are significantly impacting life sciences. Our focus is on customer satisfaction, employee success, and growth. The Product Marketing Associate Manager will be an important addition to our growing marketing team and will help support demand generation, field enablement, and customer marketing activities. This person will collaborate with global Marketing, Product Strategy, Product Management, Sales, and Professional Services to drive Veeva’s growth and our customers’ success.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Senior Manager
jobs.description_text: The Role We are seeking a Product Marketing Sr. Manager to lead U.S. product marketing for Veeva Vault CRM Suite, the leading agentic engagement platform for life sciences. You will partner closely with Market Strategy and Product Management to develop the positioning, messaging, value propositions, and go-to-market strategy for Vault CRM Suite products, including industry-specific AI capabilities. You will translate product vision and innovation, customer voice and value, and market opportunities into compelling narratives that drive customer success and growth. In this role, you will lead product launches, release marketing, sales enablement, customer advocacy, and content strategy. The right candidate will thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and is equally comfortable developing long-term marketing strategy and driving execution. Success requires a highly self-motivated and collaborative leader with the adaptability to navigate a matrixed organization, partner effectively with stakeholders, and deliver clear, compelling narratives across every customer touchpoint.

jobs.title: Product Owner (Link Key Accounts)
jobs.location_raw: Germany - Berlin · Spain - Barcelona · United Kingdom - London
jobs.description_text: The Role Help shape an emerging Veeva product and lead the engineering team’s product priorities from idea through launch. Link Key Accounts helps life sciences teams understand healthcare organizations and identify the people who influence access to treatment. As Product Owner, you’ll work closely with the Product Lead, engineering, design, and data teams to turn customer needs into capabilities that make a difference. This is a hands-on role with meaningful ownership: you’ll influence what we build, guide how we deliver it, and work directly with customers to understand its impact. You’ll tackle challenges spanning AI-powered insights, healthcare data, and intuitive workflows—with room to grow as the product expands.

jobs.title: Proposal Manager - eCOA
jobs.description_text: The Role The eCOA Proposal Manager will join our Study by Study proposal team to lead the end-to-end process for our Veeva eCOA application- from initial protocol scoping through contract execution and change order management. Drawing on clinical trial expertise, this Proposal Manager will analyze protocol requirements to determine the diaries, surveys, and/or assessments, craft accurate proposals, and support our sales Account Partners to resolve any client inquiries in the process to contracting. This is an exceptional opportunity for an impact-driven professional who excels at building scalable processes, translating complex clinical and technical requirements into winning proposals, and driving business growth in the life sciences technology space. Utilizing clinical trial systems experience and Veeva product knowledge, the eCOA Proposal Manager will structure the right solution, set the right expectations, and identify the appropriate direction, including staffing, timeframes, and associated costs.

jobs.title: Senior / Solution Consultant - Veeva Quality India
jobs.location_raw: India - Bengaluru · India - Hyderabad · India - Mumbai
jobs.description_text: The Role The Solution Consultant / Senior Solution Consultant is a customer-facing member of the Veeva Quality Solution Consulting organization responsible for translating life sciences quality and manufacturing needs into compelling, value-driven Veeva Quality solutions. The role partners closely with Account Partners, Customers, Prospects and cross-functional Veeva teams throughout the sales cycle—from discovery and qualification through solution design, demonstrations, workshops, RFP/RFI responses, proof-of-concepts and executive engagement. The successful candidate will act as a trusted advisor to Quality leaders and business stakeholders, combining domain knowledge, solution expertise, consultative selling and strong communication skills to help customers modernize quality processes and realize measurable business value from Veeva's cloud platform.
